title: 花旗杨霭仪：腾讯AI三线布局，混元、元宝、小微各司其职
speaker: Alicia Yapp

segments.en: In terms of the AI product lineup for Tencent, obviously there's been a lot of talk about work buddy being very popular.
segments.zh: 关于腾讯的AI产品线，显然元宝很受欢迎。

segments.en: What do you make of the whole lineup? Whether it's the LLM, the coding assistance and the like.
segments.zh: 您如何看待整个产品线？包括大语言模型、编程助手等。

segments.en: I mean, do you see them stacking up pretty competitively with the likes of Baba or Bite Dance now?
segments.zh: 您认为他们现在能与阿里、字节等竞争吗？

segments.en: If you look at, they did highlight three key areas.
segments.zh: 他们强调了三个关键领域。

segments.en: One is their Hunyuan model. So now it's a Hunyuan 3.
segments.zh: 一是混元大模型，现在是混元3。

segments.en: They are working on the Hunyuan 4. It's not the soda yet.
segments.zh: 他们正在研发混元4，但还不是最先进的。

segments.en: I don't think Hunyuan 4 will be the soda. They don't expect Hunyuan 4 will be the soda.
segments.zh: 我认为混元4不会是最先进的，他们也不期望如此。

segments.en: But they will continue to work on it one day. They're going to read the soda.
segments.zh: 但他们将继续努力，未来会达到最先进水平。

segments.en: And then the next thing is work buddy, which is the productivity agent.
segments.zh: 接下来是元宝，这是一个生产力智能体。

segments.en: Which is already generating some revenue, even though it's small, because it's not for everyone.
segments.zh: 它已经开始产生收入，虽然规模小，因为它不是面向所有人。

segments.en: It's for enterprise, for consumer individual professional.
segments.zh: 它面向企业、消费者和个人专业人士。

segments.en: But that actually is already quite effective.
segments.zh: 但实际上已经相当有效。

segments.en: And they will continue to work on and fine tune and potentially getting more user onboarding the work buddy.
segments.zh: 他们将继续优化，并可能让更多用户使用元宝。

segments.en: And then the third one is a consumer AI, which is the Xiaowei, the AI agent.
segments.zh: 第三个是消费者AI，即小微，一个AI智能体。

segments.en: Inside we check which in the future, you and me could actually easily maybe just using a voice and say tap into.
segments.zh: 在微信里，未来你我可能只需用语音就能轻松接入。

segments.en: And then they can function some task for us.
segments.zh: 然后它就能帮我们执行一些任务。

segments.en: So this I think they did also mention into the future, the Xiaowei is not going to use a lot of the inferencing.
segments.zh: 他们还提到，未来小微不会使用大量推理。

segments.en: Because first I think obviously the in-device inferencing could be coming along over time.
segments.zh: 因为首先，端侧推理会逐渐发展。

segments.en: But then in the meantime, the VLM, which is the model that specifically designed to fit the Xiaowei AI agent, is a very, very small model.
segments.zh: 同时，专为小微设计的VLM模型非常小。

segments.en: And then all the inferencing causes actually will be very small compared to the other LLM that we are looking at.
segments.zh: 因此推理成本相比其他大模型会非常低。
